constraints.name: credentials_access_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((token_type = 'api-key'::text) AND (agent_id IS NULL) AND (board_ids IS NULL) AND (scopes = '{}'::text[]) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL) AND (resource IS NULL)) OR ((token_type = 'oauth'::text) AND (scopes <@ ARRAY['read'::text, 'write'::text]) AND ('read'::text = ANY (scopes)) AND ((revoked_at IS NOT NULL) OR (agent_id IS NOT NULL)))))
